name: Valhalla
tagline: Open-source multimodal routing engine (route, matrix, isochrone, elevation)
description: Valhalla is an open-source routing engine built on OpenStreetMap data. Public instances and self-hosted deployments expose REST endpoints for routes, time-distance matrices, isochrones, map matching, and elevation. Common uses include turn-by-turn navigation, catchment analysis, and logistics ETA/distance calculations.

auth.details: Public OSM.de instance requires no API key; self-hosted and commercial hosts may add their own auth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public demo instance is free with fair-use rate limits; no paid product from the open-source project itself

rate_limits: not published for the public OSM.de demo; treat as fair-use / community-hosted
use_cases: compute driving or walking routes between two points
build a travel-time matrix for multiple origins and destinations
generate isochrone polygons for reachability analysis
map-match GPS traces to the road network
sample elevation along a path or at coordinates
